info.name: SkillBridge WebSocket Collection
info.description: WebSocket requests for SkillBridge chat and realtime notifications. Notifications use the same per-user socket as chat. Connect to /api/v1/chat/ws/{user_id}; pending unread notifications are sent after connection. Notification types include SERVICE_BOOKED for tutors, SERVICE_APPROVED and SERVICE_REVISION_APPROVED for tutors, and SERVICE_UPDATED for students booked on an upcoming service.

request.description: Use this connection for chat and notifications. Incoming frames can have event values: new_message, history, read_receipt, typing, notification, or error.
